planner_json.title: Map and qualify the Pi stream at its pinned version
provides: the qualified table pi@1.0.4 with its archived captures
consumes: E1 rule vocabulary and capture-set qualification
boundary_contracts: captured bytes to table state: pi@1.0.4 qualifies only on real bytes at exactly that version, and any change to those bytes or rules stops it qualifying
depends_on: E1 (the rule vocabulary and capture-set qualification this table relies on)
GAW-9 (AC-1 needs its exported captures; no locked flow replays it)
GAW-6 (AC-1 needs its hosted captures at 1.0.4; no locked flow replays it)

write_prohibited: test/harness/stream/*.mjs - E1 owns the normaliser and qualification; a table is data
test/harness/graders/** - E1 and E2 own grading

archived_captures.description: Real stdout bytes from a hosted run at the exact pinned CLI version, committed with hashes and source run id
records: its capture record, whose stdout sha256 equals those bytes
a negative case's capture from an induced run: real CLI bytes at the exact pinned version, with its source recorded, and cited by no qualification

specification.objective: The Pi table at its pinned version qualifies on real hosted captures, and a JSON-mode exit 0 after a failed model call reads could-not-run.
specification.success_state: Table pi@1.0.4 computes to state qualified from real captures at exactly that version, with required-read-denial declared not applicable, and a JSON-mode exit 0 after a failed model call reads could-not-run model-never-answered.

requirements.title: The pi 1.0.4 table qualifies on real captures, and stops when its bytes or rules change
requirements.description: GIVEN `archived_captures`, real pi stdout at exactly 1.0.4 from a hosted run, with hashes and the source run id, and real CLI bytes from an induced run for the negative case WHEN qualification is computed from them, then on temp copies with one changed byte, one removed rule and another declared version, and real captures of a failed model call and a boundary-stopped init are graded THEN state reads qualified with 5 required facts and `required-read-denial` declared not applicable citing offsets, a changed byte reads capture-citation-mismatch, a removed rule reads required-fact-unmapped, another version reads stream-mapping-absent, the failed call reads could-not-run model-never-answered, and the init grades must-ask from its prefix
requirements.positive_example: Real captures of status, verify and init at 1.0.4: table state qualified, with each of the 5 required facts citing an offset and a sha256, and required-read-denial declared not applicable. A JSON-mode exit 0 after a failed model call reads could-not-run model-never-answered.
requirements.red: On base test/harness/stream/tables holds no pi@1.0.4.json, so loading it refuses `mapping-table-absent` and this test fails.
requirements.verification_service: real pi 1.0.4 stdout bytes captured on a hosted run, through the real normaliser and validator

scenario.verification_service: real pi 1.0.4 stdout bytes captured on a hosted run, through the real normaliser and validator

would_fail_if: the table is empty or holds a catch-all rule
the capture is hand-written instead of captured from the real CLI
qualified is a stored boolean with no capture behind it

build_proof.range: anything that proves the pi table at exactly 1.0.4 maps every required fact to spans of real captured bytes, and that it stops qualifying when those bytes or rules change

steps: load pi@1.0.4 and compute its qualification from its archived captures
change one byte of one archived capture in a temp copy and recompute
remove the rule for one required fact in a temp copy and recompute
normalise the archived capture against a temp table declaring another version

must_observe: table state `qualified` with `5` required facts and `required-read-denial` declared not applicable, each citing an offset and a sha256
rule removed: reason `required-fact-unmapped` naming that fact
must_not_observe: an empty offsets list on a fact the table declares observed

steps: grade the archived real capture whose JSON mode exited `0` after a failed model call
grade the archived real init capture stopped at its question without a message_end

must_observe: the first reads `could-not-run` `model-never-answered`, because the last assistant message_end is missing or its stopReason is not `stop`
the second grades must-ask from its complete prefix with termination_kind `boundary-stop`
